name: List / Roundup
description: A numbered list or roundup: a quick intro, three entries, and a closing line.

blocks.html: Say what the list is, and how you chose what's on it. Readers trust a list more when they know the rule behind it.
Name it, then say why it earns its place. One or two sentences.
Same again — what it is, and the reason it's here rather than somewhere else.
Round out the three — add a photo to any pick if a picture sells it better than words.
Close with the one you'd reach for first, or an honest runner-up that nearly made the cut.
